text:
ana: Observed intermittent keystore decrypt failures during private deploy soak after the svcaccount scoping change. Logs show a spike in TIME_WAIT and CLOSE_WAIT.
omar: saw the same. conntrack_count near nf_conntrack_max, lots of ephemeral ports to kms.private:443.
jen: are agents opening short-lived sockets or failing TLS renegotiation? which keystore version?
ana: keystore-agent v0.9.1-canary, rolled 90m before failures. telemetry indicates retry storms when handshakes fail.
raj: quick triage: bumping nf_conntrack_max mitigates symptom but not root cause. Prefer agent-side connection pooling or HTTP/2. Avoid tcp_tw_recycle.
ana: proposed actions:
- add structured audit event on every keystore-agent handshake
- apply a NetworkPolicy to restrict egress from keystore-agent to kms proxy on 443
- instrument agent to reuse sockets and export handshake_retry counter
- change control: automated helm canary rollback if keystore auth error rate >0.5% over 3m OR conntrack_used >75% for 5m
jen: also evaluate mTLS/session resumption to reduce TLS handshake churn; mTLS rollout needs HSM sync for Private.
omar: I tested increasing nf_conntrack_max to 400k and throttling retry backoff; services recovered. Will push a canary with keepalive changes.
raj: forensics checklist: collect /var/log/keystore-agent/*.log, kube-audit events for 90d, conntrack dumps, and packet capture on a single canary node.
ana: security-bot — open an incident, archive current audit logs to secure storage, and schedule a tabletop sim once stable.
security-bot: Incident INC-2024-2120 created (P2). Audit logs archived. Next steps assigned to ana and omar.
